book.name: Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela
book.title: Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela Pa Pataŋani Todi Kisim Bek—Eksodus

content: Pataŋani inim liim ve tol: Isis tivot

Muri ghoro, Yoova isaav pa Mose ighaze: “Ula ughita kinik to Isip muul. Pasa, you taug to nagham yesŋa uraata toni ŋgar todi iyaryaaŋ. Leso nagham mbeb gharatooŋadi tintina tivot ila lolodi, ve napatooŋ tapirig padi.

Ve muri inim kamos pa yam Israela, leso asavia pa ndinatumim ve nditimbumim, ve asaav padi aghaze: ‘Muuŋ, Yoova ipatooŋ tapiri pa yes Isipa. Ye igham mbeb gharatooŋadi tintina tivot ila lolodi, ve ipamogheran di le tiwaghamgham kat.’ Ve yam asob pale awatag aghaze you Yoova nanepneep, ve aghazooŋ pa gabuag toman ŋgar tiou.”

Yoova isavsaav le isob, ghoro Mose yesuru Aron tila tivot to kinik, ve tisaav pani tighaze: “Yoova, Maaron to yei Hibrua, aliŋa ilat payom muul ighaze: Yom ukaria zoraaŋ saveeŋ wa. Pale ŋeez o uput aghem pani ve uneep ila samba? Upul tamtoghon toni tila, leso timbees pani ve tisuŋ pani.
Ighaze uŋguruut di muul, upatum ghom. Pasa, bozo mboŋmaagh, ye pale igham isis tivot, ve tiwaghamun ndug tiom.

Isis to pale tivot, nene sorok maau. Pale titatab taan tiam, le aghita taan maau. Tovenen aniiŋ eŋaeŋa to ais iwaghamun di maau, isis pale tipasob di le tisob kat. Ve ai tisob to titub ila uum tiam lolodi ne paam, isis pale tighan suvun rauadi.

Yamŋa uraata tiom ve ival tiina to Isip paam, ruum tiam pale tivon kat pa isis. Muuŋ kat, sawa to nditimbumim tinim tigham ndug tonene, ve inim imuul aazne, aghita isis tovene tivot pa eta sone.” Mose isavia saveeŋ tonene le isob, ghoro itoora, ve ipul kinik, ve ivot ila pumuri.

Yes uraata to kinik tisaav pani tighaze: “Wai kinik, pa piiz to yom ughaze upul ŋgeu tonowen igham pataŋani pait? Yom uwatag maau? Ndug to Isip isami wa. Upul nditamoot to Israel tila tisuŋ pa Maaron todi Yoova.”
Tovenen tila tigham Mose yesuru Aron timuul tinim, ve kinik isaav padi ighaze: “Aazne, you nayok payam pa ala asuŋ pa Maaron tiam Yoova. Eemoghon naghaze nawatag: Sei masin kat to pale tila?”

Mose ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Yei nisob pale nila. Ndolman, ndipain, ndinatumai nditamoot ve ndiliva, toman sipsip, mekmek, ve makau tiei tisob paam. Pasa, nighaze nila nigham lupuuŋ tiina ve nisuŋ pa Yoova.”

Tovenen kinik isaav pani muul tovene: “Ighaze nayok payam pa ala, nene avaat Yoova ineep toman gham ve poia toni iza tiam. Eemoghon irau napul ndizwamim ve ndinatumim tila toman gham ne maau. Maau le maau kat! Pasa, ŋgar samia eta avaat ineep ila lolomim.
Tovenen yam nditamoot moghon irau ala ve asuŋ pa Yoova. Pasa, mbeb tonenen, to yamru azorzoorndug pani.” Ye isavsaav padi le isob, ghoro izurun Aron yesuru Mose tighau pa mata, ve tivot tila pumuri.

Ghoro Yoova isaav pa Mose ighaze: “Ukaak nimam iza, ve upatooŋa iŋarua taan isob to yes Isipa. Leso isis ndiŋndiŋ ndiŋndiŋ tivot, ve tiwaghamun aniiŋ toman mbeb pida to titub ila taan todi. Sa mbeb to ais iwaghamuni maau, nene pale isis tipasobi.”

Tovenen Mose iit titi toni iza, ve ipatooŋa iŋarua taan isob to yes Isipa. Ghoro Yoova igham yaghur tiina ilaagh pa taan dige to ineep ila pa ndag iza, ve inim. Yaghur ilaagh pa ndag le mboŋ mboŋ ve ndugizau. Tauto iviviir isis tivot.
Isis to tivot ne, sorok maau. Katindi kat. Ve tineep irau taan isob to Isip, ve tiwaghamun ndug todi. Muuŋ ve inim, isis tovene tivot izi Isip pa eta sone. Ve muri paam, irau tivot muul maau.

Tovenen isis titatab taan isob to yes Isipa, ve tigham taan iyasosooŋ. Ve tighan suvun mbeb tisob to ais iwaghamun di maau ne le tisob kat. Tighan kikiliiŋ, ndoor, aniiŋ, ai rauadi, ve anoŋadi paam. Taan isob to yes Isipa, mbeb mbiti eta ineep muul maau.
Tovenen rikia moghon kinik to Isip imbaaŋ pa Mose yesuru Aron tinim, ve isaav padi ighaze: “You nagham sosor tiina kat pa Maaron tiam Yoova, ve nagham sosor pa yamru paam.
Lolomim isamin ghou muul, ve apul sosor tiou tonene. Irau nagham sosor muul maau. Ve asuŋ Maaron tiam Yoova pa indiir pataŋani tonene payei. Pa vene, nisob nimatmaat.”
Tovenen Mose ipul kinik ineep, ve ila isuŋ pa Yoova.
Yoova ilooŋ suŋuuŋ toni, ve itoor yaghur ve ilaagh pa ndag izila ve inim toman tapiri, le iviviir isis tonowen tisob tila pa Te Kaviaaŋa. Eta ineep muul izi Isip maau.
Eemoghon Yoova igham kinik ŋgar toni iyaryaaŋ muul. Tovenen ipul yes Israela tila maau. Igham 4:21
Pataŋani inim liim ve paaŋ: Ndoroom tiina ivot izi Isip

Muri ghoro, Yoova isaav pa Mose ighaze: “Ukaak nimam iza, leso ndoroom tiina ivot izi Isip. Ndoroom tiina to pale ivot, nene ite kat. Yes Isipa pale tiyamaana tighaze nene poia maau, ve igham di titaŋtaaŋ ve tiwandabndab tinimale yes to matadi pisi.”
Tovenen Mose ikaak nima iza, ve ndoroom tiina ikau Isip, le ineep irau mboŋ tol ve ndag tol.

Ndoroom tiina tonowen ivot le yes Isipa irau tiwaghiton di maau. Tovenen mboŋ tol ve ndag tol tonenen, yes irau tilaagh maau. Tineep ila ruum todi moghon. Eemoghon ndug to yes Israela tineep pani, nene ghazooŋa.

Tovenen kinik to Isip ipoi Mose imuul inim, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Yam Israela ala asuŋ pa Yoova. Yamŋa ndizwamim ve ndinatumim asob ala. Eemoghon yam irau apul makau, sipsip, ve mekmek tiam tineep izi Isip.”

Eemoghon Mose isaav pani ighaze: “Ee-e, vana maau. Pale nimundig toman ŋgai tiei tisob. Irau nipul eta ineep maau. Pasa, yei taumai nikankaan pa sa mbeb to pale nigham di tinim watooŋrau pa Maaron tiei Yoova. Tovenen yei irau niyou di tisob tila toman ghei. Nila nivot sa ndug to Yoova ighaze nineep pani ve nisuŋ, ghoro ye tau pale isaav payei pa sa mbeb to pale nigham di tinim watooŋrau pani. Mbeb pida, pale nimoz suruvu moghon inim watooŋrau. Ve pida, yab pale ighan suvun di.”
Eemoghon Yoova igham kinik ŋgar toni iyaryaaŋ muul. Tovenen lolo pa ipul yes Israela tila maau.
Ve izurun Mose ighaze: “Ughau pa matag. Ve umuul unum sualen malep! Ighaze naghita ghom muul, yom pale umaat.”
Tovenen Mose ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Poia. Saveeŋ tauto usavia. Irau ughita ghou muul maau.”

footnotes.text: Maaron kaarom eez to yes Isipa, iza Ra. Yes Isipa tighur ila tighaze ye maaron to iŋgin ndag. Ŋgeu Tiina igham ndoroom tiina ikau Isip, leso yes Isipa tiwatag tighaze ye tapiri ilib pa maaron todi tonowen.
